text:
Maria: Quick sync — pulled notes from 3 onboarding calls today (Acme, Brightline, NorthBay). Putting raw asks here, want to batch into product backlog before EOD.

Maria: Top pain points / requests (short):
```
- Acme: per-route cost breakdown in Console, they want to slice by customer id + route
- Brightline: onboarding checklist too long, ask for 'starter templates' and mapping examples
- NorthBay: embeddings version drift — results worse after model update, need pinned model option
- Support: wants searchable example queries + recommended prompts for edge-cases
- All: clearer retry/fallback behavior in docs + a sample fallback config
```

Maria: Note: Acme flagged renewal risk if per-route costs not visible (they're onboarding 10 teams). :warning:

Alex: Thx. Can you attach the raw call notes to the backlog ticket? @Devin can you triage priority? :eyes:

Devin: On it. I need: repro snippets for NorthBay (example input + output), and a sample Console screen shot for Acme's expectation. I'll create individual cards and tag for effort estimates.

Sarah: I can export the Brightline onboarding flows and sample mapping. Also have a short 2-slide enablement deck we can ship as 'starter templates'. I'll drop links here in a sec.

Maria: Added raw notes to the Google doc: https://docs.google.com/xxx (private) — highlights in comments.

Devin: Created backlog EPIC INF-4820 and 4 subtasks: cost-ui, onboarding-templates, embeddings-pin, support-playbook. Estimated T-shirt sizes in the description.

Alex: Prioritization suggestion: 1) per-route cost (ACME risk), 2) embeddings pin (quality regression), 3) onboarding templates, 4) support playbook. Can we get a quick spike for cost UI by next week?

Devin: Spike started. Will do a 3-day discovery, scope endpoints needed and mock-ups. Assigning to @dev-ui and @infra-team.

FeedbackBot: New CS capture created: INF-4820 (linked). Use /cs-sync to add updates to healthcheck.

Maria: Sweet. I'll update renewal tracker and ping ACME success lead with proposed timeline. Thanks all.
